role: Exploratory new-date pilot selected before any new-date Jev response or model metric

selection.rule: Within each frozen source stratum, take the smallest SHA256(namespace|seed|original_slate_id) priorities; then restore original chronological order

evaluation.conditions: For both comparisons: pooled primary conditional CI lower bound > 0; primary point gain > 0 in every fixed seed and every user route; all seven point guards pass

budget.new_paid_run_authorization: Must be confirmed at the final AutoDL create/start action because this pilot exceeds the previous cap

limitations: This 10000-slate pilot opens part of the previously untouched 50000-slate cohort; it is exploratory and does not replace a full heldout confirmation.
The remaining 40000 slates stay unevaluated and must exclude these pilot IDs in any later formal confirmation.
Logged-exposure pseudo-slates are not an online randomized experiment.
Point guards do not prove simultaneous population improvement on every goal.
No result-dependent sample extension, model change, threshold change, or pilot-ID replacement is allowed.
